Columbia Cove RV Park
=====================

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| RV-Park-Sign_2017_728x558 | View-from-RV-Park_Winter-2020_728x546-1 **Winter 2019-2020** |

  
[View RV Park Map (pdf)

Opens in new window](https://www.cityofbrewsterwashington.org/Images/Departments/Public%20Works/Columbia%20Cove%20RV%20Park/RV-Park_2015-Image_2018_Large.jpg?t=202404091135070)  
  
RV Park FeaturesReservation requests will be accepted via email (shown below) at midnight, January 2, 2025..  
29 full-hook-up sites with water/power/sewer.  
5 Overflow (power only) sites are also available.  
The RV Park bathhouse has been constructed and is now open. It will be an RV park exclusive!  
There will be a fee for dry camping this year with the exception of Derby Weekend.  
  
Columbia Cove RV Park RatesEffective January 1, 2025

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| **Military/Veteran/First Responder DISCOUNT IS AVAILABLE** |  |
| RV Daily Rates | $54.00 |
| RV Weekly Rate | $334.00 |
| RV Monthly Rate | $710.00 |
| Power Only Daily (Sites 30-34) | $42.00 |
| Power Only Weekly (Sites 30-34) | $262.00 |
| Power Only Monthly (Only available Oct. 1 – Mar. 28) | $551.00 |
| Dry Camping (Dirt Lot), RVs ONLY | $18.00 |
| Dump Fee | $12.00 |
